title: AIECA launch marks new chapter for education agents
summary_en: A “new era” for Australia’s education agent sector has been marked with the launch of the Australian International Education Counsellors Association (AIECA), formed through the merger of ISEAA and ECAA.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: AIECA launch marks new chapter for education agents

title: Scotland and Wales to pilot phone outreach for international graduates
summary_en: A new graduate outcomes pilot will contact international alumni by telephone from December 2026 as the sector seeks stronger evidence of graduate outcomes beyond the UK.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: Scotland and Wales to pilot phone outreach for international graduates

title: Crizac takes 37% stake in ForeignAdmits
summary_en: The deal marks Crizac's latest move beyond student recruitment as it expands into education finance and visa preparation services.
author: Abhishek Nair

title: Irish ELT providers hail new rules for language students moving to HE
summary_en: ELT providers in Ireland have welcomed a new measure that lets eligible international students stay in the country between completing an English language program and progressing to higher education.
author: Beth Kennedy
title_cn: Irish ELT providers hail new rules for language students moving to HE

title: From civic universities to civil universities
summary_en: In her June edition of Beech-side Views, Diana Beech reflects on the role of universities in rebuilding trust in a divided political landscape.
author: Diana Beech
